title: Verification Result
description: Structured result of a Docker-based fix verification run. Generated by the result-analyzer sub-agent in Step 3.

exit_code.description: Exit code from the Docker container. Can be integer or string 'TIMEOUT'.

output_matches_expected.description: Whether the container output contains the expected_behavior pattern

old_error_gone.description: Whether the original failure signature is absent from the output. null when no failure_log was provided.

key_output_lines.description: Key lines from the output (pass/fail summary, error messages). Maximum 20 lines.

docker_command.description: The exact Docker command that was executed (copy-paste ready)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the verification completed

issues.description: List of issues found. Only populated when verdict is not PASSED.

suggestion.description: Suggested action to resolve the issue

old_error_details.description: Details about the old error comparison. Only present when failure_log was provided.

old_error_signature.description: Extracted error signature from the failure_log

found_in_output.description: Whether the old error signature was found in the new output

match_lines.description: Line numbers where the old error was found (empty if gone)

next_action.description: Recommended next step based on the verdict
